services.name: Events & Exhibitions
services.desc: We warmly invite you to experience an interactive art exhibition at the Bath House Cultural Center this late August. Presented by Côlab, Longing is inspired by two enduring symbols of Vietnamese culture, the nón lá (Vietnamese conical hat) and the lồng đèn Trung Thu (Mid-Autumn lantern), the installation bridges memory, tradition, and community. As visitors wander beneath shimmering lanterns, gentle melodies and soft light respond to their movement, inviting everyone to become part of the experience.
